summary: PDF Solutions Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a mixed shelf takedown offering of 4,568,308 common shares at $44.00 per share, of which 1,261,384 are primary shares and 3,306,924 are secondary shares from a selling stockholder. The public offering price of $44.00 represented a 13.6% discount to the $50.95 closing price on May 12, 2026. Proceeds to the company are ~$53.0M; none from the selling stockholder's shares. Underwriters include Morgan Stanley, Wells Fargo, Societe Generale, Needham, Rosenblatt, D.A. Davidson, Northland. This is an ordinary secondary/primary offering, not a special situation. No special categorization applies.
